prompt: A sample of gas has a density of 1.40 kg m^-3 at a pressure of 1.05 x 10^5 Pa. What is the mean-square speed <c^2> of the gas molecules?
distractor_explanations: Option 2 is incorrect: this omits the factor of 3, calculating p / rho = 7.50 x 10^4 m^2 s^-2.
Option 3 is incorrect: this takes the square root, finding root-mean-square speed c_rms = 474 m s^-1 instead of mean-square speed.
Option 4 is incorrect: this uses an incorrect factor or arithmetic inversion.
hints: Recall the density form of the kinetic theory equation: p = (1/3) * rho * <c^2>.
teacher_walkthrough: State the density formula: p = (1/3) * rho * <c^2>.
Rearrange to make <c^2> the subject: <c^2> = 3p / rho.
Substitute values carefully: (3 * 105000) / 1.40 = 225000 = 2.25 x 10^5 m^2 s^-2.
